CUPS raster stream adaptation

The grey raster page headers and modified PackBits encoder in
apps/server/src/invoice-raster-encode.ts are adapted from
OpenPrinting CUPS v2.4.10, cups/raster-stream.c:
https://github.com/OpenPrinting/cups/blob/v2.4.10/cups/raster-stream.c

Copyright © 2020-2024 by OpenPrinting.
Copyright 2007-2019 by Apple Inc.
Copyright 1997-2006 by Easy Software Products.

Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0. You may obtain a copy at
https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
The licence ships alongside this notice as ../licenses/Apache-2.0.txt.

Waitron adapts the page-header serialization and row compression to
TypeScript for one-channel, 8-bit grey A4 pages at 300 or 600 dpi.
CUPS is used as a development reference; this adaptation adds no CUPS
runtime daemon or native library to the image.
